radiusSource: Radius 1.1 Jupiter radii from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since HD 39091 b does not transit, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html): 78,641.2 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 14.1 Jupiter masses (Damasso et al. 2020, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2020A&A...642A..31D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...642A..31D/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
orbitalPeriodSource: Damasso et al. 2020 (2020A&A...642A..31D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DAMASSO_ET_AL__2020): P 2088.8 d

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray. No image, colour, map or oblateness of HD 39091 b is measured; only its size, mass and orbit are.

massSource: 14.1 Jupiter masses: Damasso et al. 2020, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2020A&A...642A..31D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...642A..31D/abstract).
